files.note: Changed between the releases only in the shipped build: 9.0.0 no longer emits source maps, so dist/modules/cases.js lost its trailing sourceMappingURL comment. The source is unchanged, so the claim stands.

Changed between the releases only in the shipped build: 9.0.0 no longer emits source maps, so dist/schemas/cases.js lost its trailing sourceMappingURL comment. The source is unchanged, so the claim stands.

Bulk writes now validate their case IDs, bulk add checks for an empty array, list timestamps are checked, and soft-delete mode is captured before dispatch. The configured bindings and accepted request shapes still match.
Bulk case schemas now require nonempty positive safe identifier arrays, and the add comment describes the existing wire wrapper. The reviewed MCP shape already meets those requirements.

sources.supports: moveCasesToSection validates the section ID and the case_ids list, sends the section ID as the only path segment, forwards the JSON body unchanged and resolves with no value. The driver documents suite_id as required even for a same-suite move and section_id as path-only, never in the body.
MoveCasesToSectionPayloadSchema declares a nonempty case_ids array of positive safe integers and suite_id as a required number.
move_cases_to_section/{section_id} moves cases to another suite or section; section_id is the target section, suite_id the target suite and case_ids the list of cases, all required.

input_policy.notes: Strictness is an MCP boundary requirement at every depth. The body carries the case identifiers and the target suite only; the target section is the path argument and is refused in the body.

outer_result.notes: The method resolves with no value and the wrapper reports data: null; a moved case must be read afterwards for its new section. One request moves every listed case.

requirements.description: Reject unknown top-level fields before driver invocation rather than forwarding or discarding them.
Reject an unknown body field rather than forwarding it, including a section_id that belongs in the path.
Send exactly one request, however many cases are listed. The adapter never splits the list or reads the moved cases back.

parameters.semantics: No coercion. The target section; passed positionally and sent verbatim as the only path segment.

wire.encoding: Decimal integer path segment; numeric strings are rejected rather than coerced.

parameters.semantics: No coercion. The JSON object is passed as the driver's second argument and sent unchanged.

requirements.description: Preserve the object at driver argument 1 as the JSON request body.
Accept an object carrying the case list and the target suite.
Reject a body that is not an object before driver invocation.

parameters.semantics: The cases to move. The boundary and driver require a nonempty list of positive safe integers, sent as a JSON array.

wire.encoding: JSON array of integers under case_ids.

parameters.semantics: The suite the target section belongs to, required even for a move within the same suite. The driver forwards any number, so the boundary holds it to the identifier domain; sent as a JSON number.
